data.$description: Everything numeric and structural. Engineered to disambiguate 0/O, 1/l/I and 6/8, which is the exact failure a character sheet must not have.

display.$description: Character name and section heads only. Equipment signage, not fantasy.

chip.$description: Trait chips and rank letters. The smallest type in the product.

body.$description: Default. At or above 16px so iOS never zooms a focused field.

stat.$description: A derived number read at a glance, such as AC or a save.

hero.$description: The one number a screen is about.

name.$description: The character's name. The only place the sheet stops being a spreadsheet.

spin.$description: One revolution of an indeterminate progress indicator. A loop, not a transition, so it is not derived from the transition durations. Reduced motion stops the rotation outright rather than shortening it.

hold.$description: How long a destructive action must be held before it fires. A delay, not an animation: reduced motion must not shorten it, or the guard against a mid-session mis-tap disappears for the people who set that preference.
